arms.G+M: planner-assisted reference, reported with its planner calls (P10d)
arms.geometry_only_TOP1: analytic pose geometry proposer, no IK (P10d)
arms.historical: frozen K-B-full#s1 (200 updates), P9 unique / PoE checkpoints

calibration: temperature (p7_eval.fit_temperature) and admission threshold (p8_select rule over {0.5, 0.7, 0.85, 0.95}) chosen on the 12 P8c validation roots per checkpoint and frozen before any P10a label; never refit on P10a or disclosed test

execution_protocols_P10d.TOP1_COMMIT: primary: one learned choice, zero planner calls on alternatives; plan / execute only the choice
execution_protocols_P10d.TOP5_PRECOMMIT: secondary, planner-assisted: up to 5 ranked candidates relocation-planned before commit (P8d)

H1.mechanism: complementarity: neither edit alone, both together enable the task (kappa = +1)
H1.primary_endpoint: per root |kappa_hat - kappa| on proof-grounded complete four-tuples

secondary: H1 gains must not degrade H2 calibration

H3.mechanism: same endpoints, opposite action order, same q0
H3.primary_endpoint: paired order choice correct: p(feasible order) > p(infeasible order), proof-grounded pairs

H4.mechanism: omission necessity / redundancy (omitted sequences evaluated independently from S0)
H4.primary_endpoint: necessity accuracy: p(omitted repair) < 0.5 iff the omitted repair is infeasible, decided omissions of witnessed repairs
secondary: TOP1 picks the strictly shorter successful repair

H5.mechanism: originally feasible task with harmful / neutral edits
H5.primary_endpoint: exploratory: TOP1 chooses the empty repair; z0-zS calibration

H6.primary_endpoint: exploratory: J error on witnessed relocations, selection

H7.mechanism: hypothetical edit succeeds, executable relocation fails
H7.primary_endpoint: exploratory: sign of p(zS[A]) - p(zR(A)) matches observed

H8.mechanism: constructor-disjoint carry-sweep obstruction (not selected with pose screens)

kappa: kappa = y(A+B) - y(A) - y(B) + y(0) on decided outcomes; predicted kappa_hat = p_AB - p_A - p_B + p_0 from ROOT-PRIOR marginals (no labels); predicted sign = +1 if kappa_hat > 0.5, -1 if < -0.5, else 0

metrics.common_all_arms: per-observed-event NLL, accuracy, AUROC, Brier, ECE of ROOT-PRIOR marginals on the same decided outcomes
metrics.own_joint_BC_only: exact root NLL of the observed bits under P_K
metrics.selection: TOP1 on the same admissible catalogue: success, abstain, false-empty, moves, known-catalogue regret (only where a VERIFIED best exists), predicted J error, C_d

splits.P10a: 14 constructibility-pilot roots: certificate-targeted construction = ADAPTIVE; never a blind holdout

statistics.binary_paired: exact two-sided binomial test on discordant roots
statistics.ci: root-cluster bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean per-root paired difference (2,000 resamples, seed 0)
statistics.equivalence: never claimed from a CI crossing 0
statistics.multiplicity: one primary each for H1, H3, H4 (and the TOP1 execution endpoint in P10d); everything else exploratory
statistics.power_rule: an arm-endpoint with < 5 decided independent roots is UNDERPOWERED: descriptive only, no inferential claim

status_values.BUDGET_INFEASIBLE: policy-relative operational 0 under pinned OPNEG-v1 (all declared seeds clean), never a proof
status_values.CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE: independently checked sound certificate within its stated scope (0); pick-side only, no place-side certificate
status_values.VERIFIED_FEASIBLE: complete re-checked witness incl. target and SAFE_RETREAT (1)

strata.operational: at least one component BUDGET_INFEASIBLE, none missing
strata.proof_grounded: every component outcome VERIFIED or CERTIFIED
strata.undecided: any component UNKNOWN / NOT_RUN: excluded from the endpoint, counted in yield

unit_of_analysis: independent reference root (constructor seed). Candidates, orders, omissions, scene edits, appearance variants and near-duplicates of one root are dependent and never resampled as independent replicates.
